summary: Final frozen-source review found no remaining actionable TASK512 ownership defects. Lease single-close, listener lifetime, staged publication and alternating-journal recovery remain sound for cooperative process death. Both prior candidate follow-ups are addressed. The earlier 92cb review is stale and is not final evidence.
evidence: E1: /private/tmp/disk-steward-512-final.YakDXv/Sources/DiskStewardCore/IPC/UnixSocketEvidenceServer.swift:25-46; local fd has one failure defer and enters stored ownership only after validation/flock succeed.

E2: Same server:61-103,199-245,432-464; alternating checksummed slots retain prior directory proof, directory journaling precedes bind, endpoint journaling precedes exclusive publication, and public cleanup requires recorded identity. Failure cleanup checks its owned endpoint identity.

E3: Same server:229,252-298; listener is nonblocking, cancellation handler alone closes it, and epoch validation plus accept share stateLock. Tests:280-301 hold an old callback across stop/restart and assert descriptor retention and successor response.

E4: Same server:398-415 selects a compact service-specific staging directory beneath a sufficiently short current-user-private ancestor. /private/tmp/disk-steward-512-final.YakDXv/Tests/DiskStewardAppTests/IPC/SocketOwnershipRegressionTests.swift:373-389 constructs a public path plus NUL exactly equal to sun_path capacity and checks two successful starts/connections.

E5: Same tests:160-182,202-220,304-318; a requested checkpoint exits 17, while unexpectedly reaching completed startup exits 18. The harness requires 17, so skipped checkpoints can no longer masquerade as boundary coverage. Tests exercise repeated partial-journal recovery with existing slots.

E6: Same tests:74-158,223-277 preserve unknown public listeners without probing, regular/symlink occupants, replaced public sockets and replaced staging directories/files. Frozen Sources/DiskStewardApp/main.swift:18-23 retains the separate application lifetime lease.

risks: Long-path fallback still requires a suitably short current-user-private ancestor; the main app support hierarchy satisfies this per parent context. Arbitrary custom hierarchies can fail closed.
Recovery assumes cooperative ownership of the journaled private staging workspace; hostile same-UID pathname replacement is outside that guarantee.
Process-exit tests do not establish filesystem power-loss durability.
Backend handler cancellation and cross-epoch connection capacity remain open under TASK541.
